documents.title: Prayer in Song — Chapters 3 & 4
documents.description: Manuscript chapters on the psalms and early Christian song, with study charts and discussion questions.

documents.title: Exegesis of Acts 20:7–12
documents.description: An examination of Paul’s gathering at Troas, the raising of Eutychus, early Christian worship, and Luke’s portrayal of apostolic authority.

documents.title: Exegesis of Luke 1:39–56
documents.description: A study of the Visitation and Magnificat, tracing Old Testament parallels, divine promise and fulfillment, and the characterization of Mary and God in Luke’s Gospel.

documents.title: Exegesis of I Corinthians 4:1–13
documents.description: An analysis of Paul’s rhetoric, apostolic stewardship, humility, and divine judgment, including a comparison with the Beatitudes.

documents.title: The Nature of Sacred Scripture
documents.description: A theological essay exploring revelation, inspiration, the formation of Scripture, and approaches to interpretation.

documents.title: A New Angle on SAS
documents.description: An investigation of side-angle-side congruence as an axiom of neutral geometry and its relationship to alternative triangle-congruence foundations.

documents.title: Holy Cross Procession — Presider and Ministers Draft
documents.description: The September 1, 2026 planning draft for the September 13 procession, including the schedule, minister roles, prayers, hymns, and concluding prayer service.
